# fjordrun_agents (Data Source)

A team's agents.

## Example Usage

```terraform
variable "team_id" {
  type = string
}

data "fjordrun_agents" "all" {
  team_id = var.team_id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `team_id` (String) Team ID.

### Read-Only

- `agents` (Attributes List) The agents. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--agents))
- `id` (String) Identifier of this result.
